$comment: Machine-readable design contract. tokens.css must match these values; scripts/check-manifest.mjs fails the build when they drift. Apps never read this file directly; they use the Tailwind preset and the library components.

detailPage.asideSplit: lg:grid-cols-3 (main col-span-2, aside col-span-1; equals 8/4 of 12)
rules: One DetailHeader band per detail route
Actions go in the rail when a rail exists, otherwise in the header
Tabs are DetailTabs or DetailSheet tabs (underline), never segmented pills
Field labels are small/medium/muted, values are body/medium
Rail rows always live inside RailRows (gap-3), never a bare div
